specs.value: Amazonia Ver.2 9L (104-060), Ver.2 3L (104-061), Ver.2 Powder 3L (104-063), Amazonia PRO 9L (104-028)
Ver.2 comes with Amazonia Supplement, a pellet-type solid nutrient for the bottom of the substrate
About 6.6–6.8. It doesn't lower water pH much.
1 × 9L bag for a 60×30×36 cm tank; 1.5 bags for 60×40×40 cm; 3 bags for a 90 cm tank; 5 bags per 1 m²
3L per ~5 gal or 9L per ~15 gal; one 9L bag gives about 4 in (10 cm) depth over 1 sq ft
Finer grain for small or nano tanks, or as a thin top layer over the normal grain
The 3L powder bag doesn't include Amazonia Supplement
Professional grade with more nutrients, for vigorous long-term plant growth. Keeps water slightly acidic.
Earlier versions. Ver.2 is a renewed Amazonia II made from the same raw materials, with the Supplement added.
Some Vietnamese shops list Amazonia II 9L as out of stock

prices.variant: Amazonia Ver.2 9L (stock low; phone to confirm)

fits.fact: Made for planted tanks. The nutrient-rich soil supports plant growth, and its high cation exchange capacity helps keep water clear.
ADA says Ver.2 suits both beginners and experienced aquascapers, and it is easy to manage early on.
The black colour makes green plants stand out.
Powder grain suits nano tanks or a thin top layer for carpeting plants.
Early ammonia becomes very toxic to fish and shrimp if pH rises above 7. Hard (high-KH) tap water raises this risk.
Ver.2 keeps water slightly acidic. In ADA's own test, pH was about 5.8–6.2 over the first six weeks.

usage.fact: Spread Amazonia Supplement evenly on the tank floor, then add the soil on top.
Vietnamese shops suggest pairing it with ADA Power Sand and a base nutrient layer underneath.
Water changes for a new tank: 30% daily in week 1, three times in week 2, twice in week 3, then weekly once stable. Change water more often after 6–12 months.
In ADA's test, ammonium was 5.0 mg/L at two weeks and undetectable by about week 6. Don't add livestock until ammonia is near zero.
Humic acid can tint water yellow at first. It is harmless, and water changes or NA Carbon clear it.
If early cloudiness comes from bacteria, ADA suggests a UV sterilizer. Check tap-water pH before each water change.
Some hobbyists dark-start the tank for 2–3 weeks and do a big water change before planting.

issues.fact: Ver.2 leaches a lot of ammonium in the first weeks, and hobbyists report spikes on dark starts.
Reported cycling times range from about 2 to 6 weeks. One user still measured ammonia of 2 ppm on day 23.
The added Supplement makes Ver.2 release more nitrogen early on than older Amazonia II.
Products from other brands sold under the name 'Aqua Soil' are not ADA Amazonia. Watch for repacked or fake bags.
Vietnamese stock is patchy. Several shops list Amazonia II as sold out or ask buyers to call about Ver.2.

alternatives.why: Considered beginner-friendly because it releases little ammonia during cycling. It does get softer and crumble over time.
Buffers pH about as well as Tropica (pH around 5.5–6.5) and is less messy. One Singapore review puts its price at about 70% of Tropica's.
A volcanic soil for planted tanks that serves as a mid-priced alternative.
